description: In Manager.io (Northwind Traders), you need to manufacture a batch of gift bundles. First, enable the 'Production Orders' module via the Customize/Settings menu if it is not already visible. Then, create a new Inventory Item for the finished good: Name='Beverage Bundle', Code='BUNDLE-2025', Description='Holiday pack with Chai and Chang'. Finally, create a Production Order to produce 10 units of 'Beverage Bundle'. The production should consume 10 units of 'Chai' and 10 units of 'Chang' from inventory. Save the order.
